summary: The document notes that under Dr. Rodgers's direction, multiple rare plant specimens were successfully transplanted to areas outside the project, with May 1975 observations confirming the transplants were thriving.
text: Under the direction of Dr. Rodgers, specimens of ginseng, American climbing fern, wintergreen, witch alder, and lysimachia have been transplanted to areas outside the project. Table 4.2 shows the number of specimens transplanted. Applicant reports that observations made in May 1975 showed the transplants to be thriving.
